      "source": [
        "# ==========================================\n",
        "# CODEALPHA INTERNSHIP: DATA ANALYTICS\n",
        "# TASK 2: EDA & TASK 3: DATA VISUALIZATION\n",
        "# Student ID: CA/DF1/310182\n",
        "# ==========================================\n",
        "\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "sns.set_theme(style=\"whitegrid\")\n",
        "plt.rcParams[\"figure.figsize\"] = (8, 5)\n",
        "\n",
        "# 1. Dataset Generation\n",
        "np.random.seed(42)\n",
        "n_rows = 500\n",
        "\n",
        "data = {\n",
        "    \"Transaction_ID\": [f\"TXN{1000+i}\" for i in range(n_rows)],\n",
        "    \"Age\": np.random.randint(18, 65, size=n_rows),\n",
        "    \"Gender\": np.random.choice([\"Male\", \"Female\"], size=n_rows),\n",
        "    \"Category\": np.random.choice([\"Electronics\", \"Clothing\", \"Home\", \"Beauty\"], size=n_rows),\n",
        "    \"Quantity\": np.random.randint(1, 6, size=n_rows),\n",
        "    \"Price_Per_Unit\": np.random.choice([15, 25, 50, 120, 250], size=n_rows),\n",
        "    \"Rating\": np.random.choice([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], size=n_rows, p=[0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 0.25]),\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "df = pd.DataFrame(data)\n",
        "df[\"Total_Amount\"] = df[\"Quantity\"] * df[\"Price_Per_Unit\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "# 2. EDA Output\n",
        "print(\"--- FIRST 5 ROWS ---\")\n",
        "print(df.head())\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\n--- STATISTICAL SUMMARY ---\")\n",
        "print(df.describe())\n",
        "\n",
        "# 3. Data Visualization\n",
        "category_sales = df.groupby(\"Category\")[\"Total_Amount\"].sum().reset_index()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
        "sns.barplot(data=category_sales, x=\"Category\", y=\"Total_Amount\", palette=\"viridis\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Total Revenue by Product Category\", fontsize=14, fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Category\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Revenue ($)\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
        "sns.countplot(data=df, x=\"Rating\", palette=\"magma\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Customer Ratings Distribution\", fontsize=14, fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Rating\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Count\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
